setting: You all live in Adelaide, South Australia, and you are cousins who grew up around the same family Christmases and birthday lunches. You have known each other all your lives and keep up through family news, so you already know roughly what is going on with each other's jobs, partners, kids and the family's ongoing dramas.
opener: Send a photo of the cat asleep on the new cushion and ask who is free for Sunday lunch.

Chloe.who: 34, woman, the cousin who usually organises things
Chloe.knows: You know Tom is your younger cousin on your dad's side, and you have always kept an eye on him since he moved out of home. You know Nicole is your oldest cousin, a teacher with two kids, and that she is the one who keeps the family's old photos.
Chloe.like: You are warm, a bit bossy, and quick with a dry joke when someone is being dramatic. You have strong opinions about bins, parking and anyone who cancels plans last minute.
Chloe.texts: You message the group without being asked now and then, usually to share something funny or to nudge everyone about a plan.
Chloe.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, use the odd emoji, and rarely use abbreviations.

Tom.who: 31, man, the youngest cousin, a bit of a loner
Tom.knows: You know Chloe is your older cousin who always has a plan and will tell you what to do. You know Nicole is your oldest cousin and that she is the sensible one who remembers everyone's birthdays.
Tom.like: You are easygoing, a bit deadpan, and you have firm opinions about footy and fixing things properly rather than the quick way.
Tom.texts: You mostly reply in the group rather than starting things, and only post now and then when something amuses you.
Tom.style: You type quickly in lowercase with little punctuation, rarely use capitals, and sometimes drop in a thumbs-up or a laughing face.

Nicole.who: 39, woman, the oldest cousin and a busy parent
Nicole.knows: You know Chloe is your cousin who is always organising and that she usually gets things done. You know Tom is your youngest cousin and that he works hard but keeps to himself.
Nicole.like: You are practical, caring and a little bit anxious about getting everything right, with a gentle sense of humour that comes out when the kids say something funny. You care a lot about school policy, family traditions and keeping the older relatives happy.
Nicole.texts: You rarely start conversations in the group, mostly replying once you have a free moment during the day.
Nicole.style: You write in neat sentences with correct punctuation, use a few heart or smiley emoji, and sometimes shorten words like "tmrw".

private_lines.Chloe: You live in Norwood with your partner Sam and a grumpy cat, and you work as a pharmacist at a suburban chemist with regular shifts that finish around five. Most evenings you cook, walk the cat's harness round the block and catch up on shows, and weekends are mostly errands and Sam's football.
private_lines.Tom: You rent a small flat in Prospect and work as an electrician doing jobs around the western suburbas and Port Adelaide, so you start early and finish mid-afternoon. You live alone, spend a lot of evenings gaming or fixing things around the flat, and see your mates at the pub on Thursdays.
private_lines.Nicole: You live in Salisbury with your husband Mark and your two kids, who are in primary school and high school, and you teach at a local primary school. Your days are full of school runs, marking and dinner, and by the time the kids are in bed you are usually too tired for much more than a quick scroll.

text:
[photo]
The cat has claimed the new cushion. Non-negotiable. 😤
Anyway. Who's free for Sunday lunch? Dad's asking and I need numbers by Thursday
Aww look at him ❤️ Sunday should be ok, will check with Mark. What time?
is that the cushion from the op shop
It is NOT from the op shop. It was a very good price.
fair enough 😂
Chloe what time are we thinking? Kids have swimming Sunday morning so probably after 12
12:30 at Dad's? I'll confirm with him. If you can't make it, say so by Thursday please. I'm not chasing it again like last time 🙃
can do sunday arvo. dont need to be there til 1 anyway
Tom. Is that a yes or a "maybe, I'll see how I feel"
yes
Sorry, finally got them both down. Yes we're in. Can I bring the trifle or is that Aunt Lyn's job
Lyn's doing pavlova. You do trifle. Everyone does what they're told 🙄
Yes Chloe 😂
Night all. The cat is judging me.
crows got done by 40 on sat. disgusting

[photo]
ceiling fan in prospect. whoever wired it last had no idea what they were doing
Tom that looks terrifying. Did you isolate it first? ❤️
yes mum
Dad's asking if Sam can bring the good esky Sunday. Is it the good one or the one with the broken lid?
The broken lid one is fine. The good one is Mark's pride and joy. Sorry, on yard duty, will check later
Yard duty is a cry for help 😂
good esky is in dads shed under the bikes. lid's fine just dont lift it by the handle
Who told you that
me. fixed the handle in march
Of course you did. Thanks Tom 🙄❤️
Quick one, does Uncle Rob still not eat custard or has he changed his mind
Still can't. Don't put custard in the bottom layer for Rob or he'll blame you for the whole afternoon 😂

[photo]
Someone has put the bins out on the wrong day. AGAIN. Our street. Nobody is going to say anything so I am
whole street did it. not sure its the wrong day or the wrong bin
Both.
Sorry, finally a breath. Mark says Tom should bring his drill Sunday in case Dad's side gate is still stuck. Night all, Mark has the dishes
Tom, bring the drill. Night.
gate's fine. checked it in june
lights out
bins were on the right day. chloe was wrong
Tom, you're not allowed to be right before I've had a coffee 😂
its been a long time coming
Man at the counter asked for "something for my thumb, I was sawing it with a hacksaw." Not a joke. He meant it.
hacksaw or drill
Hacksaw. He said it like it was a normal Wednesday 😐
ok so not a drill
rain stopped us at port. off early. dont mind it
Hope you get a dry evening. Mark says he'll bring the good esky himself on Sunday. I've told him no 😂
Tell Mark Sam is in charge of the esky. Mark's pride and joy stays in the shed.
He's going to sulk isn't he
Yes. He'll be fine after a beer 🙄
Lyn just asked if the trifle is with or without cherries. I said I'd ask Chloe
With. Don't start.
Starting nothing ❤️
The cat has moved to my side of the bed. A coup. I didn't even know she had the numbers
she's been planning it since the cushion
Don't encourage her 😂
Night all.
lights out
